goal: Make the production camera chooser behave only after a visitor interacts and keep the phone deep link readable below the sticky header.
summary: Gates the focus, iris, glint, and sweep animation behind a real chooser interaction and adds an anchor margin to the existing start section. No offer, price, contact, or route is changed.
risk: Low and reversible: CSS and client-side class changes limited to the existing homepage chooser.
requested_actions: Run exact-head CI and attach independent quality evidence.
Merge only after required checks pass.
Verify the live 390px deep link and lens tap after deployment.
public_claims: No public fact or commercial claim changed.

evidence.obsidian_context: The active Esteban vault work is the camera chooser release and its phone-first production review; this PR repairs two defects observed in that review.
evidence.project_routing: gonzaloeaguilar-bot/esteban-media PR #456, branch fix/esteban-camera-mobile-polish, head 81de51f8 at the time this payload was authored.
evidence.problem_observed: On production at 390px, a direct /#start landing placed the chooser heading from y=16.125 to y=106.125 while the sticky header ended at y=65; the first line was obscured. The production lens and sweep animation names were present with focus tick 0 before interaction.
evidence.tests_or_validation: pnpm test --run app/__tests__/home-packaging-human.test.ts app/__tests__/home-single-projects-in-chooser.test.ts passed 27 tests; pnpm typecheck passed; pnpm build completed 407 static pages. git diff --check passed.
evidence.interaction_validation: Production phone test at 390px: each of the four project cards selected the matching title, starting price and destination. After hydration, the lens tap advanced the active index from 1 to 2, focus tick from 1 to 2, and exposed em-camera-focus. The source change removes animation from focus tick 0 and applies it only with .is-focusing.
evidence.reviewer_ensemble: Builder review: the diff is scoped to the component and CSS selectors responsible. Skeptic review: the two defects were reproduced from live 390px measurements before the patch. Taste review: the change preserves one camera-shaped component and makes movement a response to touch rather than ambient decoration. A separate Antigravity review dispatch was refused before provider execution because its review contract rejected the supplied invocation; it is not counted as external review evidence.
evidence.reviewer_disagreement_reviewed: No reviewer disagreement was found. The only decision was whether to leave the review findings as follow-up work; both are direct regressions of the just-shipped interaction and are fixed in this narrowly scoped PR.
evidence.winner_rationale: Gating the existing keyframed layers with .is-focusing preserves the desired focus response without adding a library or a second visual control. An 88px section scroll margin is sufficient to clear the measured 65px phone header while retaining nearby context.
evidence.ci_passed: Exact-head GitHub validate was still in progress when this payload was authored. Merge remains disallowed until its terminal success state is read.
evidence.pr_review_complete: The production behavior, local source patch, focused tests, typecheck, build and phone selector states were reviewed. No external-provider review is claimed because the sanctioned Antigravity dispatch was refused before execution.
evidence.hard_stops_checked: No price, service, location, review, credential, contact, tracking, payment, account, or destructive action changed.
evidence.obsidian_handoff: The Esteban vault hot note, durable review, index and backlog will record the PR and final deployment evidence in this session.

builder.note: Implemented the two observed production defects within the existing chooser component and passed focused tests, typecheck, build and diff checks.

skeptic.note: Production DOM and phone measurements reproduced the animation-at-load and sticky-header overlap; the patch is scoped to the exact selectors causing them.

taste.note: The motion remains a deliberate touch response, while the camera deck remains one connected component and the direct phone landing restores its reading space.
